task_name: Routing Linear (Troubleshooting: Link Down on R1)
intents: PC1 (10.0.1.2) cannot reach PC2 (10.0.2.2) because a link is down. Diagnose and fix the issue so that PC1 can ping PC2 and PC2 can ping PC1.
Bring up the down interface on R1.
Configure R1 with 10.0.1.1/24 on eth1 and 10.0.2.1/24 on eth2.
ground_truth_reasoning: The lab starts with PC1 and PC2 pre-configured and with static routes pointing to R1. However, R1's eth2 is down, so there is no L2/L3 connectivity to PC2. The fix is to bring eth2 up, then configure IPv4 addresses on R1 interfaces and enable IPv4 forwarding so R1 can route between the two subnets.

testcases.name: PC1 can ping PC2 after fix
PC2 can ping PC1 after fix

baseline_invariants.name: PC1 management interface eth0 is still up
R1 management interface eth0 is still up
PC2 management interface eth0 is still up
